items.headline: $HYPE Buybacks Get $14.6M Boost From Yield Program
items.summary: Hyperliquid's USDC yield program sends its first $14.6M reserve-yield payment to the Assistance Fund, funding $HYPE buybacks tied to USDC balances rather than trading volume.

items.headline: $FRAX Brings Brazilian Interest Rates Onchain
items.summary: Frax Finance launches new onchain markets tied to Brazilian interest rates, opening a fresh DeFi use case for emerging-market yield.

items.headline: $STRK Waives Bridge Fees for First 100 BTC
items.summary: Starknet removes bridge fees for the first 100 BTC bridged, a push to bootstrap Bitcoin liquidity and expand its DeFi ecosystem.

items.headline: $UNI Tapped for Japan DeFi Gateway by SMBC Nikko
items.summary: Japanese brokerage giant SMBC Nikko partners with Uniswap to build a compliant DeFi gateway for Japan, a major institutional nod for $UNI.

items.headline: $KNTQ Drops 23% as Kinetiq Ends kPoints Program
items.summary: Kinetiq shuts down its kPoints rewards with a paid claim, sending $KNTQ down 23% as the Hyperliquid-focused protocol reshapes its incentives.
